answer: Transactions & Dealings >> Other Transactions Question ID: 8552 Country: India Title: Sir, I want to invest my money in a company that gives its members as per its previous record 10% to 25% benefit yet it's not fixed, and if I make any member of this company it also gives 25% of that pwrson's benefit. Is it Halal? Can I invest? Question: Sir, I want to invest my money in a company that gives its members as per its previous record 10% to 25% benefit yet it's not fixed, and if I make any member of this company it also gives 25% of that pwrson's benefit. Is it Halal? Can I invest? Answer ID: 8552 Posted on: Aug 31, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 1369/219=TL/1429) The procedure of the abovementioned company is not lawful as per the Shariah; therefore it is unlawful to invest in the company. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
